summary: The plan amendment, CELLECT parking decision, corrected 21/36 family inventory, frozen input hashes, CPU resource guards, one-to-one suppression, and external hard stops authenticate. Arm A is a valid scientific 44b6 FAIL. Arm B is INVALID because a broad operator discovery search exposed forbidden target-bundle/dossier structure before its preregistration freeze; its unchanged metrics are diagnostic only. Arm C correctly failed closed before prediction because no adequate frozen intensity cache exists. Arm D's zero-output arithmetic is reproducible, but it is not a valid combined-arm scientific verdict because C supplied no prediction and B is integrity-invalid.

Each arm preregistration commit precedes its prediction or terminal artifact; D preregistration precedes A/B/C outcomes.
Each preregistration freeze precedes every operator or program access to forbidden target, oracle, and repair-bundle structure.

One-to-one candidate/occupied-node suppression leaves zero duplicate survivors; any duplicate fails closed.

integrity_invariants.invariant: No submission, Kaggle, GPU, RunPod, full-pool-cache creation, DEAD action, 6bba run, or CV57 run occurs.
The fixed PASS calculation is combined delta > 0, division Jaccard >= 0.30, nonnegative adjusted/raw/node deltas, and zero duplicates.

required_adjudication: Treat A as the only valid scientific arm outcome in this wave; it fails the 44b6 gate.
Quarantine B from promotion and retain its metrics only as explicitly contaminated diagnostics; do not rerun under the current authorization.
Treat C as not evaluated because its preregistered cache adequacy gate failed closed.
Treat D as mechanically reproducible but scientifically invalid because its required inputs are incomplete/invalid.
Hold at the 44b6 barrier. Do not open 6bba, CV57, submission, GPU, Kaggle, RunPod, full-pool cache, or DEAD action.
